decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's existing automation and infrastructure knowledge, and the firm's own R&D and research cooperation enable it to assimilate and improve it.
Product B builds directly on the firm's established water infrastructure and weir expertise, so the firm can interpret results and learn from them.
Product C is closely related to the firm's existing fouling detection and heat exchanger automation knowledge, supported by in-house R&D, making it likely to be kept.
